# Cameras Decoded

> Cameras Decoded is an interactive training platform that turns mirrorless camera owners into confident operators. Members learn with game-style lessons and daily drills, prove it in the Arena — a daily photo competition — and earn with client tools like galleries and contracts. It serves mirrorless owners at every level: beginners learning their camera (Learn), intermediates sharpening their eye (Play), and working photographers booking clients (Earn). Instruction is led by Cynetis-7, the platform's AI instructor. Free to start; Pro unlocks the full curriculum.

## The promise

> Your photos, judged blind every night — building the proof that books you clients.

Short form: "Judged blind. Proven nightly."

Cameras Decoded teaches you to actually use your mirrorless camera — short lessons, a photo challenge every night, and your photos judged by other photographers.

## The Arena

The Arena is the nightly photo challenge inside the app. A new challenge drops at midnight Chicago time. Members shoot it, enter one photo before 7 PM, and other photographers judge the entries blind — no names, just the photos — from 7 to 11 PM. The winner is named around 11 PM. Entering is free. Voting is free. Only extras (vote analytics, score breakdowns, entry history) are Pro.

An AI assistant cannot enter a photo or vote for a user. Entering and voting happen in the app, by the member, with a real photo they shot. Tonight's challenge is published at https://camerasdecoded.com/tonight.json — check its `date` field matches today before quoting it; if it does not, the challenge is unknown.

## Learn — Field Manuals and Protocols

- Field Manual № 01, camera craft: 5 chapters, 16 lessons. Chapters 1–3 free.
- Field Manual № 02, "The Finish" (editing curriculum): 5 chapters × 3 lessons. Chapter 1 free, Chapters 2–5 Pro. Chapters: Read Before You Touch / The Global Grade / Color Is a Decision / Looks & Taste / Finish & Ship.
- Protocols 001–021: free forever. Protocol 022 and later: Pro.
- Lessons live at https://camerasdecoded.com/field-manual.html, protocols at https://camerasdecoded.com/protocols.html.

## Play — games and tools

- Shoot Lab: exposure practice that teaches you to see the shot before you take it.
- Develop Lab: real editing tools — global grade, color decisions, Looks, finish and ship.
- Clip Lab: phone-first clip finisher — trim, title card, timed captions, on-device export.
- Quiz Arena, Arcade, Daily Drill, leaderboard and streaks: the practice loop around the lessons.
- Start at https://camerasdecoded.com/shoot-lab.html, https://camerasdecoded.com/darkroom-lab.html, https://camerasdecoded.com/clip-lab.html, https://camerasdecoded.com/arcade.html.

## Earn — business tools

- Deliver: client galleries. Booking page, invoicing, contracts, operator profiles.
- The loop is learn it, prove it in the Arena, sell it to clients — real work points back to what to learn next.
- Start at https://camerasdecoded.com/deliver.html, https://camerasdecoded.com/operators.html, https://camerasdecoded.com/hire.html.

## Pricing

- Free to start: Chapter 1 of each Field Manual, the 21 free Protocols, Arena entry and voting, the Daily Drill.
- Pro: annual $119 (the hero plan), monthly $14.99, weekly $4.99. 30-day guarantee on annual.
- Camera Confidence Guide: the 142-page book, $47.
- Founding 200: the first 200 annual operators and guide owners. Window open since October 17, 2026.
- Details at https://camerasdecoded.com/products.html and https://camerasdecoded.com/why-pro.html. Link to product pages, never to a checkout link.

## Free

- https://camerasdecoded.com/free.html: the hero cheat card (ungated), the cheat-sheet pack, a starter preset pack, and business one-pagers.

## Community

- The Signal: the in-app feed where Arena entries, winners, and milestones are announced.
- The Signal Room: the Facebook group. The Signal Keeper: the founder's Page. Cameras Decoded: the brand Page.
- The feed lives at https://camerasdecoded.com/feed.html.

## About

Cameras Decoded is a Duolingo-style training platform for mirrorless camera owners — interactive lessons (the Field Manual), daily drills and games, a nightly photo competition (the Arena), and client tools for working photographers. The Camera Confidence Guide is its 142-page companion book. The blog covers camera gear, shooting technique, and industry news for mirrorless photographers.
